MATCH (n)
WHERE (exists(n.class) AND n.class CONTAINS 'GraphitePressureAbsent42zeroX')
   OR (exists(n.name) AND n.name CONTAINS 'GraphitePressureAbsent42zeroX')
   OR (exists(n.caller_class) AND n.caller_class CONTAINS 'GraphitePressureAbsent42zeroX')
   OR (exists(n.caller_name) AND n.caller_name CONTAINS 'GraphitePressureAbsent42zeroX')
   OR (exists(n.callee_class) AND n.callee_class CONTAINS 'GraphitePressureAbsent42zeroX')
   OR (exists(n.callee_name) AND n.callee_name CONTAINS 'GraphitePressureAbsent42zeroX')
RETURN DISTINCT n.class, n.name, n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name
